title: Law to let residents sue over AI violations for a reward
summary: This bill would let any New Yorker file a complaint with the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection alleging a violation of the city's artificial intelligence laws. The department must investigate unless the complaint is frivolous and must share it with the Law Department, which can pursue a notice of violation or civil action. A person whose complaint leads to a recovery would get 25 percent of proceeds, or 50 percent if authorized to pursue the case themselves.
